title: Optimal Variance-Pilot Fractions for Fixed-Gap Selection Error Exponents
banked_reason: Stage 0.5 typed BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: D0.5.G tier incremental < floor field; paper_score_ceiling 5.7 < 7.4; math PASS but no bounded in-scope field repair.
gap_reasons: The matched exponent and original-data attainment are established for the stated reciprocal-menu protocol, and the framing does not assert an unproved larger-menu frontier. Relative to [Wu–Zhou, Theorem 4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/1811.12183v1), the advance is optimization over allocation and conditional-testing rules, but it remains a specialized theorem about learning a symmetric binary variance label with known scale. The broader-menu result is hard-subclass inclusion and supplies neither a richer-menu optimizer nor matching achievability, so it does not materially broaden that contribution. The logarithmic risk error of order square-root budget and the forced-count smallest-budget example leave finite-budget pilot choices and useful power gains unresolved; this limits the prospective planning significance and the projected paper score. Between field and subfield, the limited uncertainty model and absent finite-budget design characterization warrant the lower tier, despite completion of the advertised asymptotic kernel. Published theorem comparisons with [Rinott](https://doi.org/10.1080/03610927808827671), [Chick–Inoue](https://doi.org/10.1287/opre.49.5.732.10615), and [Fan et al.](https://doi.org/10.1287/opre.2023.0705) require source verification where original theorem text remains inaccessible; that access limitation is not itself grounds for this downgrade. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.7 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

proof_attempt_summary: Derived and independently reviewed the exact reciprocal-family leading exponent, all optimal pilot fractions, explicit original-data Borel attainment, full-protocol finite-risk sandwich, and same-contract broader-menu converse. Mathematics passed and the sole cited Neyman–Pearson leaf was lawfully verified-attested, but the paper-score ceiling 5.7 caps the achieved tier at incremental below the operator field floor. Exact finite-budget testing, allocation and crossover require a new program; Rinott/Chick–Inoue/Fan priority comparison remains unresolved, and no F stages or Lean certification were performed.
tldr: A discarded residual variance pilot and fresh Gaussian validation compete for a fixed observation budget. For the public reciprocal family \(\{(1,\rho),(\rho,1)\}\), \(1\le\rho\le81\), the proved result evaluates the minimax fixed-gap miss exponent, all optimal pilot fractions, and a legal original-data attaining protocol under conditional level \(1/10\) at every residual/count state. The full-class finite-risk sandwich covers all Borel randomized allocations and invariant fresh tests. Any larger positive Gaussian variance menu containing that pair inherits its finite lower bound and optimized exponent ceiling under the identical protocol and validity contract; only the converse transfers. At \(\rho=9\), the exponent is \(5C_9/(1+160C_9)\simeq0.0305035718064\), with total pilot fraction approximately \(0.0238857021945\); sublinear pilots cannot improve \(1/40\). These certificates do not compare different losses or broader adaptive design classes.
gap: Wu--Zhou already analyze discarded variance pilots and fixed-gap false-selection exponents for a named two-phase rule. Their result does not optimize every bounded-share map and every fresh test satisfying both-orientation conditional size. Local Gaussian efficiency, expected variance regret, and classical confidence or posterior-loss criteria address other decision problems.
fill: The family theorem evaluates the scalar frontier and all optimal pilot fractions, including the phase tie and homogeneous-variance endpoint. A uniform likelihood sandwich supplies the matching full-class converse, and the open synthesis question supplies legal original-data plans. The ratio-nine construction provides an explicit worked corollary.
